sourceAssessment.additiveScope: The production change is strictly additive and read-only: crates/mori-core/src/lib.rs (A06) appends `pub use stage::SourceLiabilityIdentity;` while retaining baseline module order, and crates/mori-core/src/stage/mod.rs (A07) adds `pub struct SourceLiabilityIdentity` and `StagedProgram::liability_registry(&self) -> Result<Vec<SourceLiabilityIdentity>, Error>`. No reverse backend dependency (D04), new validator, 16-cap/bound, domain/hash/context/artifact/version change, existing caller modification, or broken Q1 draft adoption is introduced.
sourceAssessment.compatibilityAndDelegation: `StagedProgram::liability_registry(&self)` delegates directly to unchanged `decode::registry_for(self.program())?` (D01) and propagates any `Error` unchanged. For `moriarty/2` (`moriarty-core/2`), `registry_for` extracts statement-declared liability identities across all actions and rejects non-empty `duties` with `mori::core::profile`. For `moriarty/3` (`moriarty-core/3`), `registry_for` unions statement liability identities across all actions with `Program.duties`, resolving each asset name via `asset_identity` and rejecting conflicts with `mori::core::liability` (statement-only) or `mori::core::sequence_duty_declaration` (duty-caused). Profile isolation in `profile.rs` (D03) and wire decoding in `ir.rs` (D02) remain completely unchanged.
sourceAssessment.completeIdentityAndOwnership: `SourceLiabilityIdentity` (A07) owns `name: String`, `asset: AssetId` (which in D02 owns `network: String`, `issuer: String`, `reference: String`, `scale: u8`), `debtor: String`, and `creditor: String`. `liability_registry(&self)` takes an immutable `&self` reference and deep-clones all 7 leaf fields (`name.to_owned()`, `asset.clone()`, `debtor.to_owned()`, `creditor.to_owned()`) into a newly allocated `Vec<SourceLiabilityIdentity>`, ensuring complete detachment from `StagedProgram` without mutating `program`, `plan`, `program_hash`, or `plan_hash`.
sourceAssessment.positiveTestCoverage: `crates/mori-core/tests/sealed_registry_metadata.rs` (A08) covers: (1) `/3` complete identity set matching (`RegistryFrame.mori`, A05, and `REGISTRY-EXPECTED.json`, A04) across 8 actions, 6 declared duties, and 2 matching `"cross"` `Statement::Liability` occurrences in `create` and `addZero`, yielding 7 distinct 7-leaf identities compared as a `BTreeSet` without inventing a backend `Vec`/ABI slot order; (2) full ownership and non-mutation by mutating all 7 leaf fields on a second directly returned `liability_registry()` vector (`name`, `asset.network`, `asset.issuer`, `asset.reference`, `asset.scale`, `debtor`, `creditor`) plus `detached.pop()`, then verifying a third `liability_registry()` query and `sp.program()`, `sp.plan()`, and `(sp.program_hash(), sp.plan_hash())` remain unchanged; and (3) `/2` compatibility (`Core2Registry.mori`, A02, and `CORE2-REGISTRY-EXPECTED.json`, A01) with 0 duties and 3 statement occurrences across 2 actions (`later`, `earlier`) yielding 2 distinct complete identities.
sourceAssessment.sealedBoundary: `StagedProgram` (A07:58-64) keeps all fields private (`program`, `plan`, `program_hash`, `plan_hash`) and derives only `Debug, Clone`—with no public constructor, `Default`, `Serialize`, or `Deserialize`. Only `stage::load` and `stage::load_v3` construct `StagedProgram` via `finish_load`. `SourceLiabilityIdentity` is a detached public metadata struct with public fields and `Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq` (no `Serialize`/`Deserialize`), so callers can construct or mutate detached metadata without forging or mutating a `StagedProgram`.
